notes: The library requires a work permit form even though this is volunteering. Library is at 13101 Schavey Rd, DeWitt. The page also lists an At-Home Teen Service Hour Program for school-year hours.
name: Summer VolunTeen program (DeWitt District Library)
what_you_do: Help library staff with craft prep, program setup and cleanup, and handing out Summer Reading prizes. Some teens can keep volunteering during the school year.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 14 by June 6 for the summer program (the VolunTeen page lists youth ages 13 to 18 in general). You need to be free for at least two 2-hour shifts a week.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were accepted April 15 to May 21. Orientation was May 27 or 28. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the VolunTeen form and a work permit form. There is one for ages 14 to 15 and one for ages 16 to 17. Then go to orientation. Email lhutting@dewittlibrary.org with questions.
